color.note: One light theme. White and pale red grounds, near-black ink, one red (the logo red) and black for the footer and the register band.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground everywhere outside a band or the footer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Pale red panels: the event row, FAQ items, odd schedule rows, the details band, the schedule-pending panel.

tokens.name: photo-ground
tokens.usage: Behind the hero photograph, which sits on it at 63% opacity.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Form fields, and text on red or black.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text. 15.8:1 on bg, 13.6:1 on surface, 17.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: date lines, notes, captions, field borders. 6.7:1 on bg, 5.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The logo red and the only red: the logo, every button, the focus ring, footer link hover. White on it is 4.59:1. As text it is 4.27:1 on bg, so red is never used for body text; the logo is exempt.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: The footer and the register band.

tokens.name: on-black
tokens.usage: Body text in the footer. 13.0:1 on black.

tokens.name: on-black-muted
tokens.usage: Fine print in the footer: copyright line, photo credit. 9.6:1 on black.

tokens.name: black-raised
tokens.usage: The copy-address button on black; turns red on hover.

type.note: Newsreader (serif, 400) for headings and statements, DM Sans for everything else, both from Google Fonts. The logo is Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold, used only inside the outlined logo files. Large sizes are fluid on the site; fontSize is the largest step and usage names the clamp.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The homepage title only, one line. Fluid: clamp(54px, 12.45vw, 190px); 12.1vw on phones.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The h1 of inner pages. Fluid: clamp(50px, 8.5vw, 120px); 54px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings (h2), band titles. Fluid: clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 64px).

styles.name: date
styles.usage: The day numeral in an event row.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We bring people together to turn an idea into something you can actually try.
styles.usage: Statements, event titles (h3), hero event lines. Fluid: clamp(23px, 2.4vw, 34px); 24px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Come with a project, a half-formed thought, or just your laptop.

styles.name: footer-heading
styles.usage: Column headings in the footer, white on black.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: UC Berkeley · Free · Schedule coming soon
styles.usage: Secondary lines, event asides, the copy button. 13px on phones.

styles.name: fine
styles.sample: © 2026 Founder Square · Student-run, not a university program
styles.usage: Footer bottom line and the photo credit.

spacing.note: Generous and even. Sections breathe; panels have big padding and no borders.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Page side margin. Fluid: clamp(22px, 4vw, 64px); content max-width 1480px.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section. 90px under 900px, 75px under 600px.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height. 82px under 900px, 80px under 600px.

tokens.name: gap-xl
tokens.usage: Between a block of text and its button in a row (signup).

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Between columns of an event row and a band; padding of panels.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Between form fields, schedule time and item, footer bottom items.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Logo mark to name, between FAQ items.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Between the two columns of About, details and schedule grids.

radius.note: Square. No rounded corners anywhere, including fields and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every panel, button, field and image.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid red outline offset 6px on links, buttons and summaries; 2px offset 2px on fields.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Input and textarea borders, in muted.

tokens.name: hero-photo
tokens.usage: The hero photograph over photo-ground.

tokens.name: hero-wash
tokens.usage: A bg-coloured wash over the hero photograph so dark text reads on it.
